name: MU_ParkingPermit_VerifyPayment
description: Serverless API. Confirms a parking-permit payment server-side with Authorize.net before the EIP workflow advances. If transId is provided it calls getTransactionDetailsRequest directly. If only registrationId is provided it searches recent unsettled transactions for a matching invoiceNumber. Returns paid=true only for an approved, captured transaction. Never trusts the caller's claim of payment.
